subject: Approval queue contract (S19): register_queue(kind, list_fn, approve_fn, reject_fn) + web registerQueueView
body:
# Approval queue contract (S19) — `apps/api/naadi_api/admin/queues.py` + `apps/web/src/admin/queues/registry.ts`

Owners: S19 (registry, routes, hub UI, `generated_media`, `pathway_checks`, `report_issues`).
Consumers: S20 registers `youtube_candidates`, S21 registers `question_review`, S15b's approve endpoint moves into `generated_media`.

## Server

```python
from naadi_api.admin.queues import (
    register_queue, QueueContext, QueuePage, QueueItem, QueueRef, QueueDecision, GateRefused, ItemGone,
)

def register_queue(
    kind: str,                                   # ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,47}$, unique; a second registration raises at import
    list_fn,    # async (ctx: QueueContext, *, limit: int, cursor: str | None) -> QueuePage
    approve_fn, # async (ctx: QueueContext, item_id: str, note: str | None) -> QueueDecision
    reject_fn,  # async (ctx: QueueContext, item_id: str, note: str | None) -> QueueDecision
    *,
    count_fn=None,  # async (ctx) -> int ; default: list_fn(limit=1).total
    ref_type: str,  # admin_audit.ref_type for decisions, e.g. 'generated_media', 'media_asset', 'question'
) -> None
```

- Call `register_queue` at **import time** of a module that `main.py` already imports (your `install_*_routes` module). The registry is process-global; `naadi_api.admin.queues.registered_kinds()` lists kinds.
- `QueueContext`: `app` (FastAPI app; use `schedule_reindex(ctx.app, ...)`), `admin: CurrentUser`, `conn: psycopg.AsyncConnection` — an **open service-role transaction** (dict rows). Do every write on `ctx.conn`; the registry writes the `admin_audit` row in the same transaction and commits after your fn returns (any exception rolls back everything).
- `QueueItem` (pydantic): `id: str`, `kind: str`, `created_at: datetime`, `title: str | None` (content's own title, not UI copy), `ref: QueueRef(type, id) | None` (deep link target: `section|question|media|chapter|generated_media|pathway_task|youtube_candidate|report`), `detail: dict[str, JsonValue]` (structured, kind-specific; **never English sentences** — the web view formats with `ui_copy`; never answer/explanation fields for anything a student path could reach — admin-only is fine here because the queue routes are `require_admin`).
- `QueuePage`: `items: list[QueueItem]`, `next_cursor: str | None`, `total: int`.
- `QueueDecision`: `id: str`, `status: Literal['approved','rejected']`, `before: dict | None`, `after: dict | None` (row snapshots, hashed into `admin_audit.before_hash/after_hash`).
- Refusals: raise `GateRefused(reason: str, details: dict[str, JsonValue] = {})` → HTTP 409 `{"error":"gate_refused","reason":<code>,"details":...}` (licence gates use reasons `no_source`, `no_license`, `noncommercial_on_paid`, `share_alike_in_proprietary`, `no_ai_ingest`, `not_embeddable`, `metadata_stale`). Raise `ItemGone()` → 404. Anything already decided → raise `ItemGone` too.
- Licence gate helper for anything that publishes an asset: `from naadi_api.admin.licence import check_publish(conn, source_id, *, target) -> None` (raises `GateRefused`), `target in {'page','rag'}`. Uses `sources` + `sources_policy`.

## HTTP (all `require_admin`, rate-limited bucket `admin`, audited)
- `GET  /api/admin/queues` → `{"items":[{"kind","count"}]}` (operation `listAdminQueues`)
- `GET  /api/admin/queues/{kind}?limit=1..100&cursor=` → `QueuePage` (`getAdminQueue`)
- `POST /api/admin/queues/{kind}/{item_id}/approve` body `{"note": str|null (≤1000)}` → `QueueDecision` (`approveAdminQueueItem`)
- `POST /api/admin/queues/{kind}/{item_id}/reject`  body `{"note": str|null}` → `QueueDecision` (`rejectAdminQueueItem`)
- Unknown kind → 404. Non-admin → 403, anon → 401.

## Web (`apps/web/src/admin/queues/registry.ts`, admin lazy chunk only)

```ts
export interface QueueViewProps { item: QueueItem; /* from @naadi/shared contracts */ }
export interface QueueView {
  titleKey: string;              // ui_copy key, e.g. "admin.queues.youtube_candidates.title"
  Row: ComponentType<QueueViewProps>;      // compact row in the list (structured detail -> ui_copy)
  Detail?: ComponentType<QueueViewProps>;  // optional expanded preview (e.g. the IFrame player, question preview)
  rejectNeedsNote?: boolean;     // default true
}
export function registerQueueView(kind: string, view: QueueView): void   // throws on duplicate
```
- Register from a module under your own source root and add one import line to `apps/web/src/admin/queues/views/index.ts` (S19 owns it; tell me and I add it, or post a claim for that one line).
- Kinds without a registered view render a generic row (title + created_at + ref link). The hub shows approve (lime, one per view: the focused item) / reject; decisions call the HTTP above; a 409 `gate_refused` shows `admin.gate.<reason>` copy.
- Every string is a `ui_copy` key `admin.queues.<kind>.*`; add them to `config/app_config.yaml` and `REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS`.

## Data (S19 migration, number claimed separately)
- `admin_audit` (backend-only, RLS forced, no client grants): `id, actor_user_id, action, ref_type, ref_id, before_hash, after_hash, note, at`.
- `question_revisions` (backend-only): `id, question_id, snapshot jsonb, author_user_id, origin ('admin'|'authoring'|'seed'), note, created_at` — S21 writes rows here on every authoring edit via `naadi_api.admin.questions.snapshot_question(conn, question_id, author, origin, note)`.
- `chapter_section_revisions` gains `status ('draft'|'published')` and `parent_revision_id`.
